verdict.rationale: Column is a developer-facing banking API platform, so an official CLI is a fair question, but nothing in the evidence documents one. The pack shows only HTTP APIs, an OpenAPI spec for generating SDKs, llms.txt and the dashboard. These are developer building blocks, not a first-party CLI, and a Column engineer said customers prefer the HTTP APIs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
